name: Grid Control
description: Connect Grid Control to Claude and access your outsourced maintenance data directly from conversations. Search work orders, suppliers, contracts, quotations, equipment, pendencies and service locations. Monitor SLA compliance, track backlog and aging, review supplier violation rankings, check equipment reliability, and import asset spreadsheets — all through natural language prompts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grid Control to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grid Control to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sammathnaur.fieldcontrol.com.br/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grid Control MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grid Control lists 51 MCP tools, including create_import, dashboard, dashboard_forms_answers, dashboard_forms_answers_detail, dashboard_products_by_storage, dashboard_storage_movements_by_day, dashboard_storage_movements_by_type, generate_upload_credential, get_company_details, get_contract_details, get_deadline_violation_reason_details, and get_equipment_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grid Control?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grid Control in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Grid Control MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grid Control requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Grid Control is developed by Field Control. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
